heading: Israeli checkpoint leaves Qusra residents trapped, settlers move freely in ‘closed military zone’
body: Four Palestinians remain trapped in the West Bank village of Qusra, near Nablus, as an Israeli military checkpoint prevents Palestinian-American Loui Abu Ridi and his family from leaving their home. What had been three besieged residents turned into four following the August 29 attack on the village

heading: Yemeni forces target Houthi positions, destroy drone boats
body: Yemen’s military says it has carried out drone attacks against Iran-allied Houthi targets across several fronts, according to the army’s media centre.

heading: Former US National Security Adviser says US blockade of Iranian oil an ‘enormous win’
body: Former US National Security Adviser John Bolton has described the US blockade of Iranian oil as an “enormous win,” saying it is having a major impact on Iran’s economy and should remain in place.

heading: With UN peacekeepers gone, can Europe fill the gap in Lebanon?
body: With the nearly 50-year UN peacekeeping mandate in southern Lebanon set to expire at the end of 2026, proposals for a European Union mission to fill some part of the vacuum have attracted attention.

heading: Iran, China foreign ministers hold talks in Kyrgyzstan
body: Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has held talks with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek, according to Tehran’s top diplomat’s Telegram channel.

heading: Iran says it’s clear US ‘stuck’ in Middle East quagmire
body: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei says mediation efforts by Pakistan and other countries are continuing.

heading: Qatar denounces Israeli ‘exploitation’ of Middle East crisis
body: Qatari Foreign Ministry spokesperson Majed al-Ansari has accused Israel of exploiting the conflict between the US and Iran to launch deadly strikes throughout the region.

heading: Iran says it will continue to resist US attacks and pressure
body: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei is holding a press conference and denouncing US “ill intentions” against his country.

heading: WFP says funding shortages cut food assistance in occupied West Bank in half
body: The World Food Programme (WFP) says funding shortages are forcing it to cut its food assistance in the occupied West Bank in half as settler pogroms intensify and Israeli army operations continue.

heading: Hamas condemns Israeli attacks as continuation of ‘war of genocide’ against Palestinians
body: Hamas has condemned Israeli attacks on Gaza today that have killed at least five people and wounded numerous others, calling it a “systematic, fascist escalation by the government of war criminal [Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin] Netanyahu”.

heading: US CENTCOM says 84 vessels redirected during naval blockade
body: US Central Command (CENTCOM) says as of today, troops have redirected 84 commercial vessels during its ongoing naval blockade against Iran.
